digest.component_or_area: documentation and ADR for multi-project tracker support
propositions: The multi-project model requires documenting store-owned project sets rather than per-repo lists as a load-bearing architectural decision.
Legacy migrations must be documented as event-free to explain why no ticket backfill occurs during upgrades.
Operators need explicit guidance on the fail-closed behavior of older binaries encountering the multi-project-bridge capability.
Configuration and Jira sync documentation currently present single-project constraint as the only option and must be updated to reflect multi-project support.
Two new ensure registry units added by the multi-project implementation must be listed alongside existing built-ins in migrations documentation.
